tests.name: 4830真实2020满体登场流血3回合，体力30%分档边界及免异失败不补抽；已有流血免弱明确待答
4830真实2020敌无流血时攻固粉先25%第三类50%、真伤不减与逐回合清种类；其他异常不误判流血
tests.assertion: const s=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true});delete s.fighters[1].ailments['流血'];s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=99;const out=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const t of['fixed','percent','fixed','true'])out.push(c.hurt(c.t,100,'三通道真实状态',t));},()=>turn(s,29182,10127));assert.deepEqual(out,[75,50,75,100]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.damageTypes2016.types,['attack','fixed','percent']);const next=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)next.push(c.hurt(c.t,100,'新回合固定首伤','fixed'));},()=>turn(s,29182));assert.deepEqual(next,[75]);

tests.name: 4830真实2020敌流血时不减伤且免控每回合前2次延长流血，第三次不延长、非控次数免异不冒充
tests.assertion: const s=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true});for(let r=1;r<=2;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const start=c.a.ailments['流血'];for(let n=1;n<=3;n++){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],start+Math.min(n,2));}c.t.counts.immune=1;assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,0);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],start+2);assert.equal(c.hurt(c.t,100,'流血关闭固定减伤','fixed'),100);}},()=>turn(s,29182));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shark2020.controls,2);

tests.name: 4830真实2020公共登场免控延长计入首回合前2次，首回合初不重置，次回合再可延长
tests.assertion:
const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.entryAilment(c.t,'害怕',2,c.a),false);assert.equal(c.entryAilment(c.t,'麻痹',2,c.a),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],5);}}};let s;try{s=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}
 observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],5);}},()=>turn(s));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],6);}},()=>turn(s));

tests.name: 4830真实2020常驻免控先于技能反弹，不反弹仍延长两次；免固清回合受免断保护
tests.assertion:
const a=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true});timer(a,0,'reflect');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const before=c.a.ailments['流血'];assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],before+1);}},()=>turn(a));
 const b=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(b,1,'固定百分比免疫');timer(b,1,'protect');turn(b);assert.equal(sum(b,'fixed'),0);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].hp,1400);assert.ok(b.fighters[1].effects['固定百分比免疫']);assert.ok(b.fighters[1].effects.protect);
